rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for physically following someone or supporting a sports team.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gan1 go2 deoi6 bo1

rows.note: Use this for keeping track of news or following an account on social media.

example.english: I use this account to follow the news.
example.traditional: 我用呢個戶口關注新聞。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 ni1 go3 wu6 hau2 gwaan1 zyu3 san1 man4

rows.note: Use this when “follow me” means understand what I am saying.

example.english: Do you follow what I’m saying?
example.jyutping: nei5 ming4 baak6 ngo5 gong2 gan2 mat1 maa3

rows.note: Use this for carrying out instructions exactly or completely.

example.jyutping: nei5 gan1 zuk1 fan6 sik6 pou2 zou6 zau6 dak1
